channel.title: Merkle Street
channel.description: Merkle Street reports crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, layer 2s, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation, security incidents and protocol upgrades.

item.title: JPMorgan puts its dollar deposit token on Ethereum
item.description: JPMorgan has put its dollar deposit token on Ethereum for institutional clients, adding a public network for onchain payments and digital asset settlement.

item.title: Ripple says OCC granted final approval for trust bank
item.description: Ripple says the OCC has granted final approval for a trust bank that will manage RLUSD reserves and custody assets, while issuance stays with its New York trust company.

item.title: Aviva puts £22bn sterling fund share class on XRP Ledger
item.description: Aviva and Ripple added an XRP Ledger share class to a £22 billion fund, representing holdings on-chain while the regulated fund and its assets remain off-chain.

item.title: Ethereum pulls Glamsterdam’s Hoodi test over contract risk
item.description: Ethereum postponed Glamsterdam’s Hoodi test to investigate how proposed gas changes could affect existing contracts; no replacement date is set.

item.title: HSBC starts retail rollout of HKD stablecoin RedCoin
item.description: HSBC has launched RedCoin on PayMe, giving users a way to send HKD stablecoins to people and merchants, with tokenised investments planned for a later phase.

item.title: HSBC launches HKD stablecoin RedCoin on PayMe
item.description: HSBC has launched RedCoin through PayMe, giving retail users a licensed HKD token for transfers and merchant payments as Hong Kong expands regulated stablecoins.

item.title: HSBC launches RedCoin payments on PayMe
item.description: HSBC has launched its HKD stablecoin on PayMe, opening wallet activation to more than 3.3 million users for transfers and merchant payments in Hong Kong.

item.title: Omnichain apps connect blockchains through messages and assets
item.description: Omnichain systems pass verified messages between blockchains so tokens and apps can act across networks, while adding new trust, timing and failure points.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow, targeting 150ms finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT with validator-to-validator votes that target finality in 150 milliseconds and could speed deposits.

item.title: Two Cross-Chain Swap Setups: Paying for Speed
item.description: A cross-chain swap can save time by paying for priority or liquidity, but gas buys block priority only where it is spent; bridge settlement still sets the pace.

item.title: Why Ethereum Congestion Makes Bridge Transfers Cost More
item.description: Ethereum fees rise when blockspace is scarce, while a bridge can add separate costs on both chains. Learn what each charge pays for before moving tokens.

item.title: OCC leaves stablecoin rewards open to crypto exchanges
item.description: The OCC’s GENIUS Act rule bars direct issuer yield but leaves exchange rewards to case-by-case review, defining how crypto platforms may share stablecoin reserve income.

item.title: OCC leaves stablecoin rewards open to crypto exchanges
item.description: The OCC’s GENIUS Act rule bars issuers from paying stablecoin interest but leaves exchange rewards to case-by-case review, keeping a key debate open.

item.title: How to Reconcile Treasury Deposits to Polygon
item.description: Match each treasury deposit to its Polygon transaction, token and destination address so bridge transfers, direct payments and fees land in the right records.

item.title: A Narrow Liquidity Range Can Turn Fees Off
item.description: A concentrated-liquidity position earns swap fees only while its price stays in range, so a tighter band can raise fee share and then switch it off.

item.title: Solana Activates Alpenglow, Targeting 150ms Finality
item.description: Anza activated Alpenglow on Solana on Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT with off-chain validator voting that targets finality in about 150 milliseconds.

item.title: Four Checks for Rango Bridge Destination Liquidity
item.description: A cross-chain quote can reach the right token and still fail on depth, slippage or contract mismatch; four checks show whether destination liquidity fits.

item.title: Why an Ethereum Nonce Can Hold Up a Bridge Deposit
item.description: An Ethereum nonce orders each wallet’s transactions, but a bridge deposit can stall before or after confirmation; the fix depends on which step is pending.

item.title: How Mantle Bridge Moves Assets Between Ethereum and Mantle
item.description: Mantle Bridge moves assets between Ethereum and Mantle through wallet transactions, token approvals and a separate withdrawal settlement and claim step.

item.title: OCC finalizes GENIUS Act rules for stablecoin issuers
item.description: The OCC has finalized rules for stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act, setting reserve, redemption and oversight standards that take effect in January 2027.
